STATEMENT OF WORK (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE)
Solicitation No.: SYN-C-0003
Title: Flight-Line Engineering Technical Services — Avionics/Airframe Disposition

1. SCOPE
This effort requires flight-line engineering technical services in
direct support of turnaround maintenance operations, focused on rapid
disposition of avionics and airframe discrepancies discovered during
pre-flight and post-flight inspection.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 Contractor engineers shall be on call to render flight-line
    engineering dispositions for discrepancies affecting aircraft
    turnaround and airworthiness.
2.2 Contractor shall coordinate with squadron maintenance control and
    engineering disposition authorities to resolve flight-line
    troubleshooting escalations within the turnaround window.
2.3 Contractor shall maintain a discrepancy disposition log consistent
    with NATOPS-referenced maintenance procedures.

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Flight line, notional Naval Air Station.
